description: Fine-grained task taxonomy for LLM routing (~30 task types), modeled on OpenRouter's task classification and common agent sub-step workloads. Each task type maps to a required capability level (L1-L5), the dominant capability dimensions that determine fitness, token sensitivity, and overqualification risk.

capability_levels.L2: Standard — summarization, simple QA, boilerplate code
capability_levels.L3: Proficient — multi-step reasoning, structured output, real code
capability_levels.L4: Expert — hard reasoning, nuanced writing, long-context synthesis
capability_levels.L5: Frontier — novel research, hardest math/logic, high-stakes accuracy

task_types.label: General Conversation
task_types.description: Open-ended chat, small talk, persona dialogue, ideation banter.

task_types.label: Summarization
task_types.description: Condense documents, transcripts, or threads into concise faithful summaries.

task_types.label: Information Extraction
task_types.description: Extract entities, facts, fields, and relations into structured form.

task_types.label: Classification & Tagging
task_types.description: Assign labels, categories, intents, or severity to text.

task_types.label: Sentiment Analysis
task_types.description: Detect sentiment, emotion, tone, or stance in text.

task_types.label: Open-Book Question Answering
task_types.description: Answer questions grounded in provided context (RAG, documents, tool results).

task_types.label: Closed-Book Question Answering
task_types.description: Answer from parametric knowledge without external context.

task_types.label: Code Generation
task_types.description: Write code from a specification or natural-language requirement.

task_types.label: Code Completion
task_types.description: Complete or infill code at a cursor or stub point.

task_types.label: Code Review & Debugging
task_types.description: Find bugs, security issues, and improvements; explain failures.

task_types.label: Code Explanation
task_types.description: Explain what code does, translate between languages, document.

task_types.label: SQL & Query Generation
task_types.description: Translate natural language into SQL/SPARQL/GraphQL against known schemas.

task_types.label: Math & Arithmetic
task_types.description: Arithmetic, algebra, calculus, word problems, quantitative reasoning.

task_types.label: Logical & Multi-Step Reasoning
task_types.description: Deduction, induction, puzzles, causal analysis, chain-of-thought tasks.

task_types.label: Planning & Task Decomposition
task_types.description: Break a goal into ordered sub-steps, choose tools, sequence agent actions.

task_types.label: Tool & Function Calling
task_types.description: Emit structured tool calls with correct arguments from context.

task_types.label: Structured Output Generation
task_types.description: Produce schema-conformant JSON/XML/YAML from free text.

task_types.label: Creative Writing
task_types.description: Prose, poetry, marketing copy, scripts, brand voice.

task_types.label: Rewriting & Paraphrase
task_types.description: Change tone, style, length, or clarity while preserving meaning.

task_types.label: Translation
task_types.description: Translate between languages, preserving meaning and register.

task_types.label: Grammar & Style Correction
task_types.description: Fix grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style issues.

task_types.label: Long-Context Synthesis
task_types.description: Analyze, compare, and synthesize across very large inputs (50k+ tokens).

task_types.label: Vision & Image Understanding
task_types.description: Describe, caption, or answer questions about images.

task_types.label: Document OCR & Table Extraction
task_types.description: Extract text, tables, and forms from scanned documents and PDFs.

task_types.label: Audio & Speech
task_types.description: Transcribe or understand audio input.

task_types.label: Image Generation
task_types.description: Synthesize images from text prompts.

task_types.label: Embedding & Retrieval
task_types.description: Produce vector embeddings for search, RAG, and similarity.

task_types.label: Moderation & Safety
task_types.description: Flag harmful, toxic, or policy-violating content.

task_types.label: Fact Verification & Hallucination Check
task_types.description: Verify claims against sources, detect contradictions and hallucinations.

task_types.label: Data Analysis & Chart Reasoning
task_types.description: Interpret tables, charts, and datasets; derive insights and statistics.
